topic: Monthly audit of a digital miner
title: Monthly Audit: Did Your Digital Miner Profit?
hook: Month's end: did your digital miner actually pay?

scenes.narration: Total the daily rewards credited this month.
Take off the maintenance charges. Net results vary and can be negative.
Rewards are in bitcoin, so the bitcoin price changes what they are worth.
One month is a snapshot, not a promise of the next one.

cta: What did yours show? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Rewards minus maintenance, for the month, is your honest net number.

sources.title: GoMining docs: maintenance fees and discounts
